review.gallery: Eight original brochure renders and one dated excavation photograph. Nearby completed towers seen behind the excavation belong to the neighborhood.
review.location: The developer’s top-down drawing shows the two-tower plot near D54. Terra Firma corroborates the approximate Madena point. Twelve driving estimates were read from the original project brief.
review.floorPlans: Twenty-four complete source drawings. The 3 BR duplex sheet shows both levels at 2,258.05 sq ft, while the launch summary gives 2,160 sq ft. The 4 BR Type A sheet shows the 14th-floor single-level drawing at 2,757.07 sq ft. The summary describes a 4 BR duplex of 4,047 sq ft. The summary figures are not attached to different drawings. The 2 BR Type D components total 1,258.63 sq ft against 1,258.62 sq ft printed.

unavailable: A complete two-level 4 BR duplex drawing at the launch summary area, separate basement or lower-ground drawings, surveyed entrance and verified completed photography.
